thread:
Alex: Quick sync — thinking about collapsing some sidebar groups into 'atomic' bundles to reduce vertical noise. rough idea below, want quick opinions.

Marina: +1 to reducing noise, but worried about discoverability for less-used items. can we keep a toast/search affordance? :thinking_face:

Sam: Love the atomic bundles idea. Can we ensure deep links still land users into exact subviews? e.g. `/console/models/123?tab=metrics` should open the bundle and focus the tab.

Casey: Agreed. Routing rules need to be explicit. Proposal: if route matches nested item, UI expands group and then scrolls to item. If group is collapsed, expand with animated focus and set aria-expanded.

Irene: Accessibility nits: when we expand group we must move focus to the first interactive element in the new region, not just rely on scroll. keyboard users need a clear focus target. Also announce via live region: "Group X expanded".

Alex: Good call. UX question — do we show breadcrumbs when inside an atomic bundle? My gut is yes, but shorter. Example: `Models / ResNet50 / Versions` -> collapse middle chunk into pill when space tight.

Marina: Breadcrumb compression sounds right. Maybe use overflow behaviour: show first + last + condensed middle (`Models › … › Versions`). Also copy tweak: replace "Versions" with "Model versions" in crumbs for clarity.

Sam: On deep links: need URL contract doc. Quick draft in thread: if you link to an item id we use `#/models/:id(/:subpage)?` on client routing. If missing subpage default to `overview`. Fallback: if id not found, route to parent list with toast `Item not found`.

Casey: Example routes to reference in PR: ```
# deep link examples
#/models/123
#/models/123/metrics
#/deploys/alpha-2024/overview
```

Irene: Also keyboard pathing: `g` then `m` should jump to Models list. If user lands via link we should not break the hotkey map. Make sure focus is set but hotkeys remain active.

Alex: UX edge: when bundle has many items and we auto-expand to deep link we should smart-scroll so selected item is at top of group view, not hidden. Visible focus ring required (high contrast).

Marina: Can we add a micro-animation when a deep-link expands? subtle slide, 120ms. helps orientation. But ensure reduced-motion respects OS setting.

Sam: Routing fallback question: when a model id exists but the requested tab isn't available for that model (e.g., metrics disabled), should we redirect to overview or show `Tab not available` page? I vote redirect with optional banner "Metrics disabled for this model".

Casey: Redirect + banner is best for minimizing broken states. Keep routes deterministic. Also maintain history: deep-link should push a new history entry so back button returns user to previous context.

Irene: Accessibility checklist for the PR: 1) aria-expanded on group toggles, 2) focus management when opening via link, 3) live region announcements for open/close, 4) keyboard shortcuts preserved, 5) skip links to main content. I'll add to the PR template.

Alex: Copy tweaks: side nav labels shorter: "Dedicated" -> "Dedicated capacity", "Private" -> "Private deploys"? which is clearer? Marina?

Marina: prefer "Dedicated capacity" and "Private deploys" (plural). Align with marketing copy but keep short. Also tooltip copy should mirror full label.

DesignBot: New design note uploaded: https://redwood.design/notes/sidenav-atomic-groups-v1 (attachment).

Sam: next steps: I'll write URL contract doc and small state machine for expand/contract logic. Casey will prototype interaction and Irene will run quick a11y smoke test. Can we target a small spike PR next week?

Alex: Sounds good. Thanks all. I'll capture the compressed-breadcrumbs spec and add the animation preference + reduced-motion doc. Tagging @Marina for copy review. :pray:

Marina: Happy to. Posting a few copy variants later today.

Casey: I'll start a Figma frame for the micro-animation and handoff notes.

Irene: Will add checklist to PR template and run keyboard walkthrough once there's a prototype.

Alex: End — leaving action items in a short thread task list in GH.
